about: The collecta of the formulary “Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord Jesus Christ, Who, being subject to Mary and Joseph, didst consecrate domestic life by ineffable virtues, grant that with the aid of them both we may be instructed by the examples of Thy Holy Family and attain everlasting fellowship with it. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
